scope: Additive zero-prefix receive Idle API; no consumer/timer/retry/resume change. Confirm legacy strict-transfer costs because it shares framing helpers.

baseline.source: 5c41d6ac2d9b40e6eead62e201d5e9b020f96019, C8 endpoint product merged through main commit 6269242

after: Bind reviewed source manifest and protected normal executable hashes before execution

host.cells: 12 cells: whole-mixed and combined-cpu, requested 1 MiB, trials 0/1/2, matched before/after per trial; reverse phase order for trial 1
host.engine: Unchanged Rust broker_objects; persistent receiver per cell, same eight targets and paid Combined checkpoint/schema setup
host.bounds: Existing Wick target, two build jobs; no concurrent SpiralCore build/coverage/performance; one cell active, Rust 512 MiB owned-store and 1 GiB sampled RSS ceilings, timeout 120 per cell and on-Wick timeout 1800 for the entire batch
host.required: Exact lengths/readbacks/paired target IDs; actual stream counters in both directions; setup, process/thread CPU, verified wall, offline readback, cleanup/lifecycle and RSS; every gain/loss retained

native.cells: Two current-source Linux/Firecracker stage two cells, whole-mixed then combined-cpu, requested 16 MiB trial 0, experimental64
native.comparison: Current Whole versus Combined only; previous source observations remain historical, not a fresh native before/after pair
native.bounds: At most two simultaneous guests, each 1 vCPU and 1 GiB RAM, no guest NIC, one cell active, existing 256 MiB disk per cell; cooperative timeout 300 per cell and timeout 1800 batch; any failure stops for owned-process reconciliation
native.required: Exact publications and additional keyless reboot readbacks, actual bidirectional/two-hop counters, sender/receiver/relay CPU and lifecycle, unchanged two links/two slots/524,288 reserved bytes and zero final usage
native.exclusions: Local native only; requested Linux experimental64 rate remains unenforced. No native RSS/aggregate plaintext-budget or WAN/fleet qualification.

custody: Original failures retained. Host Rust engine emits exact verification before owned store cleanup; native owned disks removed only after archive/member custody. Copy compact records only; normal and instrumented executables remain protected remotely, no new Mac target or payload/VM disk.
interpretation: These normal transfers still use strict receive, not the Idle consumer. Do not claim Idle wake/retry CPU, causal speedup, statistical noninferiority, energy or send-only time. Dedicated portable tests qualify Idle framing; current-profile performance is exploratory shared-host observation.
